caption:
Meta shipped an AI agent for every business.

It lives inside Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp. It replies in your tone, qualifies the lead, and books the appointment inside the thread.

More than a million businesses ran an early version before this wider rollout.

Here's the gap: it covers chat. Calls, web forms, and walk-ins get zero coverage there.

One CRM behind every channel closes that gap. Every lead, from every channel, lands in one place and gets the same fast follow-up.

DM TRIAL

#ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #LocalBusinessMarketing #LeadGeneration #SmallBusinessTech
rationale: News reels win cold-audience reach right now, and Meta's newly expanded cross-app Business Agent is a fresh, verifiable update reframed as a CRM-pipeline gap, distinct from every prior missed-call or inbox post.
